# The Arch packages CI installs to configure, build and test phosphor-components
# and phosphor-libs under it. One package per line. A comment after `#` is
# ignored.
base-devel
git
ccache
cmake
ninja
extra-cmake-modules
qt6-base
qt6-declarative
qt6-shadertools
qt6-svg
qt6-wayland
wayland
wayland-protocols
# lupdate and lrelease, for the components' catalog.
qt6-tools
# Qt declares QVulkanInstance only when the Vulkan headers are present, and
# phosphor-libs' phosphor-surfaces uses it wherever Qt was built with Vulkan.
vulkan-headers
# KF6: the components draw through Kirigami. KGlobalAccel and PlasmaActivities
# are optional lookups in phosphor-libs, installed so CI builds what they
# switch on.
kirigami
kglobalaccel
plasma-activities
# The offscreen tests' runtime.
mesa
